d: Short, charcoal-brown hair with straight bangs and a single long strand framing the face, paired with sharp, narrow golden-yellow eyes and a sullen expression on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender and petite, dressed in a white sailor-collared top with navy blue trim, a grey sleeveless bodice with silver buckles, and a short navy blue pleated skirt. Signature details include a black headband with gold lettering and a silver chain draped across the hips, while the character is accompanied by heavy grey mechanical naval artillery equipment.
